Package hadur117.core.melee

Class TeamRisk

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.TeamRisk
final class TeamRisk extends Object
The team half of the melee mover: the terms and choices MinimumRiskMovement reads only on a team (T1..T7). Teammates' risk and path terms (MMOVE-6, MMOVE-7), the soft weight of a shot by who stands nearer its shooter (TMODE-2), the pulls of GANG, FINISH and HUNT (TMODE-3, TMODE-4, TMODE-13), the teammates' bullet path check (TMODE-25) and the concord factor (TMODE-33). Off a team none of it is read, so the solo mover is the rest of MinimumRiskMovement.

    • softWeight

      static double softWeight(EnemyShot shot, Point2D.Double me, List<Point2D.Double> mates)
      TMODE-2: the share of shot aimed at Hadur, standing at me when it was fired: 1/(1+k)^2 for the k teammates in mates nearer its source.

    • pull

      static TeamRisk.Pull pull(Point2D.Double me, double energy, int others, List<EnemyInfo> enemies, long now, List<Roster.Mate> mates, Set<TeamModes.Mode> modes)
      TMODE-3, TMODE-4: the point a team member is drawn to, or null. With TeamModes.Mode.FINISH, one enemy left by the engine's count (others less the teammates in view), seen lately, and at least FINISH_ENERGY, that enemy, to FINISH_FLOOR: early in a round the tracker holds only the enemies scanned so far. Else with TeamModes.Mode.GANG: when GANG_SIZE enemies are within GANG_RANGE of Hadur, its nearest teammate; when they are of a teammate, the nearest such teammate, to HELP_FLOOR.

    • huntAssign

      static int[] huntAssign(List<Point2D.Double> pack, List<EnemyInfo> enemies, long now)
      TMODE-13: each member's prey, as every member works it out from the positions they share. Members go in name order (me as name); each takes the fresh enemy of least (distance + PACK_ENERGY_WEIGHT x energy) squared, times HUNT_CROWD when HUNT_MAX_GROUP members already hunt it. Returns the members' places as indexes into enemies, in the order of pack; -1 with no fresh enemy.

    • pathBest

      static Point2D.Double pathBest(MinimumRiskMovement move, Point2D.Double destination, List<Point2D.Double> candidates, MinimumRiskMovement.View v)
      TMODE-25, Firestarter's path check: the PATH_RERANK lowest-risk candidates and the destination held if not reached are each scored as their risk plus PATH_K times the damage of the teammates' bullets their drive would meet in PATH_TICKS ticks. The held destination keeps its place as in the plain choice: another wins only below MinimumRiskMovement.SWITCH_GAIN times its risk, both with their bullet damage.

    • concordFactor

      static double concordFactor(Point2D.Double p, EnemyInfo e, MinimumRiskMovement.View v, int i)
      TMODE-33: enemy i's factor in the team brain: 1/(1 + n) for the n robots, the other enemies seen lately and the teammates, nearer that enemy than p. A point with robots between it and an enemy is one that enemy would sooner not shoot at; there is no closest-robot doubling. A recent shooter keeps MinimumRiskMovement.RECENT_HIT_FACTOR.
